newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: INTERVIEW-Malaysia HIV cases rise, buck world trend.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Malaysia HIV cases rise, buck world trend.

text.p: The average number of people carrying HIV is increasing in Malaysia, bucking world trends, the Malaysian AIDS Council said on Monday.
A council spokeswoman, quoting Ministry of Health figures, said new cases of the human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) increased to 383 per month in 1996, up about 30 percent from 295 per month in 1995.
